description: Read a file at any commit, branch, tag or major version (like `git show <rev>:<path>`), from the git clone. commit takes a SHA (>= 7 hex), branch, tag, 17 or 9.6, <ref>~N or a commit_id; default HEAD; an unknown name or path is an error, never a silent HEAD. Returns at most 2000 lines per call: start_line/end_line pick the range, total_lines gives the length and cut=true says more follow. Lines are numbered with a tab (numbered=false gives the exact bytes). Each result has sha (cite it with the path and lines) and ref. Binary files return a note instead of content.

commit.description: Commit to read the file at: a SHA (>= 7 hex), branch, tag, major version (17, 9.6), <ref>~N, or a commit_id from another tool, or a commit URL (gitweb, git.postgresql.org, GitHub, pg.ddx.io). Default HEAD. An unknown name is an error, never a silent HEAD.

end_line.description: Last line to return (1-based, inclusive). Default: the end of the file, capped at start_line + 1999.

numbered.description: Prefix each line with its line number and a tab (default true). false returns the exact file bytes.

repository.description: Repository name, e.g. pgbouncer. Defaults to postgres when omitted. Aliases: repo, repo_name.

name: git_show_file
